attach = env.ref('liber_login_aliases.action_attach_to_site_login_copies', raise_if_not_found=False) if attach: attach.sudo().run() View = env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().with_context(active_test=False) lines = [] mod = env['ir.module.module'].sudo().search([('name', '=', 'liber_login_aliases')], limit=1) lines.append('Module: %s %s (%s)' % (mod.name, mod.latest_version, mod.state)) fallback = env.ref('liber_login_aliases.login_alias_server_fallback', raise_if_not_found=False) keep = env.ref('liber_login_aliases.login_alias_keep_typed', raise_if_not_found=False) lines.append('Server sign-in with alternative logins: %s | real login hidden after a failed attempt: %s' % ( 'on' if fallback and fallback.active else 'OFF', 'on' if keep and keep.active else 'OFF')) lines.append('') lines.append('Websites:') for site in env['website'].sudo().search([]): copy = View.search([('key', '=', 'web.login'), ('website_id', '=', site.id)], limit=1) if copy: n = View.search_count([('inherit_id', '=', copy.id), ('key', 'like', 'liber_login_aliases_'), ('active', '=', True)]) lines.append(' %s (%s): own edited login page - alias logic attached: %s' % (site.name, site.domain or '-', 'yes (%s)' % n if n else 'NO')) else: lines.append(' %s (%s): standard login page - alias logic: yes' % (site.name, site.domain or '-')) lines.append('') lines.append('Alternative logins:') Users = env['res.users'].sudo().with_context(active_test=False) aliases = env['x_login_alias'].sudo().search([]) if not aliases: lines.append(' NONE - add them on the user: Settings > Users > Alternative Logins') for alias in aliases: name = (alias.x_name or '').strip() clash = Users.search([('login', '=ilike', name.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('%', '\\%').replace('_', '\\_'))], limit=1) if clash: state = 'NOT USED - it is the real login of %s' % clash.name elif not alias.x_user_id.active: state = 'NOT USED - user archived' elif name != name.lower() or name != alias.x_name: state = 'ok (signs in as %s; stored as "%s")' % (alias.x_user_id.login, alias.x_name) else: state = 'ok - signs in as %s' % alias.x_user_id.login lines.append(' %s -> %s: %s' % (name, alias.x_user_id.name, state)) lines.append('') lines.append('Sign in with an alternative login and the user\'s normal password. If the real login with the same password also fails, the password is the problem.') raise UserError('\n'.join(lines))
